newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight rates slip, money markets liquid.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight rates slip, money markets liquid.

text.p: Egyptian overnight interbank rates slipped in a private sector market flush with funds left over from the central bank's bond offer to 9 1/4 and 9 3/4 on Thursday from 10 1/4 percent on Tuesday, bankers said.
Borrowers did not show up in the Egyptian private interbank market on Wednesday due to large liquidity left over from the treasury bond offer.
One-week bank rates were also lower at 9 3/8 to 10 3/8 percent from 10 1/4 percent.
The central bank offered seven-year bonds worth four billion pounds and received applications for bonds worth 10.119 billion. The bonds carry a fixed interest rate of 11 percent.
